verses.text: James, a bond-servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes who are dispersed abroad: Greetings.
verses.textZh: 作神和主耶穌基督僕人的雅各請散住十二個支派之人的安。

verses.text: Consider it all joy, my brethren, when you encounter various trials,
verses.textZh: 我的弟兄們，你們落在百般試煉中，都要以為大喜樂；

verses.text: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.
verses.textZh: 因為知道你們的信心經過試驗，就生忍耐。

verses.text: And let endurance have [its] perfect result, so that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.
verses.textZh: 但忍耐也當成功，使你們成全、完備，毫無缺欠。

verses.text: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all generously and without reproach, and it will be given to him.
verses.textZh: 你們中間若有缺少智慧的，應當求那厚賜與眾人、也不斥責人的神，主就必賜給他。

verses.text: But he must ask in faith without any doubting, for the one who doubts is like the surf of the sea, driven and tossed by the wind.
verses.textZh: 只要憑著信心求，一點不疑惑；因為那疑惑的人，就像海中的波浪，被風吹動翻騰。

verses.text: For that man ought not to expect that he will receive anything from the Lord,
verses.textZh: 這樣的人不要想從主那裡得甚麼。

verses.text: [being] a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
verses.textZh: 心懷二意的人，在他一切所行的路上都沒有定見。

verses.text: But the brother of humble circumstances is to glory in his high position;
verses.textZh: 卑微的弟兄升高，就該喜樂；

verses.text: and the rich man [is to glory] in his humiliation, because like flowering grass he will pass away.
verses.textZh: 富足的降卑，也該如此；因為他必要過去，如同草上的花一樣。

verses.text: For the sun rises with a scorching wind and withers the grass; and its flower falls off and the beauty of its appearance is destroyed; so too the rich man in the midst of his pursuits will fade away.
verses.textZh: 太陽出來，熱風颳起，草就枯乾，花也凋謝，美容就消沒了；那富足的人，在他所行的事上也要這樣衰殘。

verses.text: Blessed is a man who perseveres under trial; for once he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which [the Lord] has promised to those who love Him.
verses.textZh: 忍受試探的人是有福的，因為他經過試驗以後，必得生命的冠冕；這是主應許給那些愛他之人的。

verses.text: Let no one say when he is tempted, 'I am being tempted by God'; for God cannot be tempted by evil, and He Himself does not tempt anyone.
verses.textZh: 人被試探，不可說：「我是被神試探」；因為神不能被惡試探，他也不試探人。

verses.text: But each one is tempted when he is carried away and enticed by his own lust.
verses.textZh: 但各人被試探，乃是被自己的私慾牽引誘惑的。

verses.text: Then when lust has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and when sin is accomplished, it brings forth death.
verses.textZh: 私慾既懷了胎，就生出罪來；罪既長成，就生出死來。

verses.text: Do not be deceived, my beloved brethren.
verses.textZh: 我親愛的弟兄們，不要看錯了。

verses.text: Every good thing given and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom there is no variation or shifting shadow.
verses.textZh: 各樣美善的恩賜和各樣全備的賞賜都是從上頭來的，從眾光之父那裡降下來的；在他並沒有改變，也沒有轉動的影兒。

verses.text: In the exercise of His will He brought us forth by the word of truth, so that we would be a kind of first fruits among His creatures.
verses.textZh: 他按自己的旨意，用真道生了我們，叫我們在他所造的萬物中好像初熟的果子。

verses.text: [This] you know, my beloved brethren. But everyone must be quick to hear, slow to speak [and] slow to anger;
verses.textZh: 我親愛的弟兄們，這是你們所知道的，但你們各人要快快的聽，慢慢的說，慢慢的動怒，

verses.text: for the anger of man does not achieve the righteousness of God.
verses.textZh: 因為人的怒氣並不成就神的義。

verses.text: Therefore, putting aside all filthiness and [all] that remains of wickedness, in humility receive the word implanted, which is able to save your souls.
verses.textZh: 所以，你們要脫去一切的污穢和盈餘的邪惡，存溫柔的心領受那所栽種的道，就是能救你們靈魂的道。

verses.text: But prove yourselves doers of the word, and not merely hearers who delude themselves.
verses.textZh: 只是你們要行道，不要單單聽道，自己欺哄自己。

verses.text: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man who looks at his natural face in a mirror;
verses.textZh: 因為聽道而不行道的，就像人對著鏡子看自己本來的面目，

verses.text: for [once] he has looked at himself and gone away, he has immediately forgotten what kind of person he was.
verses.textZh: 看見，走後，隨即忘了他的相貌如何。

verses.text: But one who looks intently at the perfect law, the [law] of liberty, and abides by it, not having become a forgetful hearer but an effectual doer, this man will be blessed in what he does.
verses.textZh: 惟有詳細察看那全備、使人自由之律法的，並且時常如此，這人既不是聽了就忘，乃是實在行出來，就在他所行的事上必然得福。

verses.text: If anyone thinks himself to be religious, and yet does not bridle his tongue but deceives his [own] heart, this man's religion is worthless.
verses.textZh: 若有人自以為虔誠，卻不勒住他的舌頭，反欺哄自己的心，這人的虔誠是虛的。

verses.text: Pure and undefiled religion in the sight of [our] God and Father is this: to visit orphans and widows in their distress, [and] to keep oneself unstained by the world.
verses.textZh: 在神我們的父面前，那清潔沒有玷污的虔誠，就是看顧在患難中的孤兒寡婦，並且保守自己不沾染世俗。
